## 📌 Pull Request Description

### Summary
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed or feature implemented. Include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes # (issue)

---

## 🛠️ Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Code styling / UI polish
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization
- [ ] 🔒 Security patch

---

## 🧪 Testing Checklist
- [ ] `npm run build` in `Client/` succeeded with **0 errors**.
- [ ] Backend server runs without unhandled exceptions.
- [ ] Tested across screen sizes (Mobile, Tablet, Desktop).
- [ ] Verified dark/light mode compatibility.
- [ ] Verified authenticated vs unauthenticated access states.

---

## 📸 Screenshots / Demos (if applicable)
Add before/after screenshots or recordings of your changes here.
